risklayer.summary: Spark is a Sky/Maker ecosystem capital allocator with roughly $4.8B TVL across eight chains, offering SparkLend (Aave v3 fork), Spark Savings vaults, and a $2.1B cross-chain liquidity layer. It has operated since 2023 with no direct fund losses and one of DeFi's stronger audit programs (22+ tier-1 reviews, $5M Immunefi bounty). Primary risks are deep Sky/USDS dependency, 13 unverified contracts (22%) including L2 governance executors, executive control via Sky's SubProxy rather than SPK token voting, and acute SPK token unlock pressure in June 2026. Overall risk is moderate at 4.9/10.

details.name: Dependency Risk
details.description: Deep Sky/Maker stack coupling (USDS vault, SSR, PSM) is a root single point of failure; Chainlink-primary SparkLend oracles lack a configured fallback, and ALM integrates a wide surface of external venues (Aave, Ethena, Curve, CCTP, LayerZero).

details.name: Smart Contract Risk
details.description: Mature Aave v3-fork and ALM architecture with strong access controls, but 13/58 contracts (22%) are unverified—including PoolConfigurator, L2 executors, and ALM Controllers—and SubProxy holds centralized upgrade authority without an on-chain timelock.

MainnetController holds this role and can route capital through Aave, Curve, CCTP, LayerZero, PSM, and other integrations. ALMProxyFreezable adds FREEZER role to revoke controllers. Compromise of a RELAYER key or governance spell error could move funds across integrated protocols within rate-lim…

keyFindings.title: Executive Control via Sky Parent, Not SPK Holders
keyFindings.description: On-chain verification shows SubProxy wards are held by Sky Pause Proxy (0xBE8E3e36…) and Spark StarGuard (0x6605aa12…), not SPK token holders. SubProxy owns PoolAddressesProvider, is ACL admin, holds POOL_ADMIN and EMERGENCY_ADMIN on ACLManager, and DEFAULT_ADMIN on ALM MainnetController. SPK governance is off-chain Snapshot signaling; execution requires Sky Atlas updates and executive spells.

keyFindings.title: No Timelock on SubProxy Direct Execution
keyFindings.description: SubProxy.exec() performs immediate delegatecall execution for any address with wards. While StarGuard enforces a 7-day maxDelay for whitelisted proxy spells, the SubProxy contract itself has no built-in timelock. Sky Pause Proxy can authorize and execute changes without an on-chain delay at the SubProxy layer.

keyFindings.title: Unverified Arbitrum Spark Executor
keyFindings.description: Cross-chain governance on Arbitrum routes L1 SubProxy messages through ArbitrumReceiver (l1Authority=SubProxy) to Spark Executor 0x65d946…f7a1, which is unverified on-chain. This creates a governance asymmetry: mainnet contracts are verified and auditable, but the primary Arbitrum execution target cannot be source-audited.
